title: The Biggest Comics in Courtyard History Just Dropped Into Packs
summary: Courtyard.io has new comic book packs that allow comic book collectors to buy, sell, and trade comic books digitally, or redeem them phyiscally.
body_markdown:
***TL;DR:*** *Comic Packs just got a major upgrade. Six options (Pro, Master, Ultra, Platinum, Diamond, and Legend) replace our era-based packs, bringing more publishers and every era into every pack. Discover a wider lineup, including some of the biggest books in Courtyard history.*


Not every comic reboot wins fans over (looking at you, One More Day). This one will.


Starting today, our era-based Comic Packs are making way for six new options:[Pro, Master, Ultra, Platinum, Diamond, and Legend.](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=comics) Instead of choosing a time period, you can explore every era in every pack, with more publishers represented than ever before.


Think 9.8 Bronze Age books, jaw-dropping Modern variants, hard-to-find low-grade Silver Age and even signed books from Stan Lee, Todd McFarlane and a few Hollywood stars.


Whether you're hunting a first appearance or discovering your next favorite cover, there's more waiting inside.


**Legends Start Here**


Meet the new[Comic Legend Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/comic-legend-pack) , headlined by two of the biggest books ever to hit Courtyard:


- **X-Men #1 in an eye-watering CGC 8.0:** The issue that started it all for the X-Men (FMV: $38,000)
- **Amazing Fantasy #15 CGC 2.5:** Spider-Man’s first appearance and the undisputed king of the Silver Age (FMV: $23,292)


**Endgame Encore**


Avengers: Endgame is back in cinemas, so let's assemble! From Captain America’s return to Thor’s first appearance, here’s one standout hit waiting in each of the six Comic Packs:


- Comic Pro Pack: Avengers #88, CGC 9.8 White Pages. Highest grade available (FMV: $800)
- Comic Master Pack: Avengers #4, CGC 4.5. 1st Silver Age Captain America (FMV: $1,289)
- Comic Ultra Pack: Tales to Astonish #27, CGC 4.5. 1st Ant-Man (FMV: $2,759)
- Comic Platinum Pack: Avengers #1, CGC 5.0 VG/FN. 1st Avengers (FMV: $5,385)
- Comic Diamond Pack: Incredible Hulk #1, CGC 2.0. 1st Hulk (FMV: $9,108)
- Comic Legend Pack: Journey Into Mystery #83, CGC 5.5. 1st Thor (FMV: $11,629)


Which grail is on your list? Explore the new[Comic Packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=comics) and find your next big discovery (with odds better than beating Thanos…)


‍
